exposure: Type of uterine fibroids (III, IV, V)
Timing of fibroid removal (before or after uterine incision suture)
cohort: 190 pregnant women with uterine myoma undergoing cesarean section
finding: Both endometrial myomectomy and serosal myomectomy are safe and feasible for removing intramural myomas larger than 8 cm during cesarean section, with EM having advantages in shorter operation time and less blood loss, and SM, when performed before suturing the uterine incision, can further shorten the myomectomy time.
